summary: Very quiet weekend across partners: no programme or commission news from the networks or retailers.
Kobo's support team reminded a reader that publishers decide which books are sold in which countries, so a title can be missing in one store region.
Other partner posts were routine book promotion and were left out.

items.title: Kobo: publishers decide content availability by region, so a title may not be available in your location
items.why: A small reminder that the same book isn't sold everywhere. Sending each reader to a store and edition that actually exists in their country is exactly why localised links matter.
